title: Policy question, then asks for a person

turns.customer: Quick question before I use Paylane for something big: how do refunds work? Is there a limit?
turns.reply: In this chat I can refund a settled card purchase in full if it's $75 or less, less than 30 days old, hasn't been refunded before, and your card isn't frozen. Each transaction is judged separately, so there's no overall cap. Purchases over $75 or 30 days or older, and money sent to another person, go to a person on our support team to review. Pending charges have to settle before they can be refunded.
